ayahs.textUthmani: حمٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حمٓ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: حٰم࢜ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Ḥā, Meem.
ayahs.transliteration: Haa-Meem
ayahs.translationClear: Ha, Meem.

ayahs.textUthmani: عٓسٓقٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عٓسٓقٓ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: ع࢜س࢜ق࢜
ayahs.translation: ʿAyn, Seen, Qāf.[1405]
ayahs.transliteration: 'Ayn-Seen-Qaaf
ayahs.translationClear: Ayn, Seen, Qaf.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذٰلِكَ يُوْحِيْٓ اِلَيْكَ وَاِلَي الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَۙ اللّٰهُ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and to those before you - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: Kadhaalika yoohee ilayka wa'ilal-ladheena min qablikallaahul-'azeezul-hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: Thus He inspires you, and those before you—Allah the Almighty, the Wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِؕ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.[1406]
ayahs.transliteration: Lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi wahuwal-'aliyyul-'azeem
ayahs.translationClear: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. He is the Sublime, the Magnificent.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ ۚ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ‌ۚ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ وَالْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ يُسَبِّحُوْنَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ لِمَنْ فِي الْاَرْضِؕ اَلَا͏ٓ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: The heavens almost break from above them,[1407] and the angels exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allāh who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Takaadus-samaawaatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna wal-malaa'ikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fil-ardi alaa innallaaha huwal-ghafoorur-raheem

footnotes.1407: i.e., from the grandeur of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) above them.

ayahs.translationClear: The heavens above them almost burst apart, while the angels glorify the praises of their Lord, and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Allah is indeed the Forgiver, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُ حَفِيْظٌ عَلَيْهِمْؗۖ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيْلٍ
ayahs.translation: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allāh is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muḥammad], are not over them a manager -
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheenattakhadhoo min doonihee awliyaa'allaahu hafeezun 'alayhim wamaa anta 'alayhim biwakeel
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who take masters other than Him: Allah is in charge of them, and you are not responsible for them.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ فَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ‌ۚ فَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكَ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰي وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهِؕ فَرِيْقٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيْقٌ فِي السَّعِيْرِ
ayahs.translation: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it[1408] and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: Wakadhaalika awhaynaa ilayka qur'aanan 'arabiyyal litundhira ummal-quraa waman hawlahaa watundhira yawmal-jam'i laa rayba feehi fareequn fil-jannati wafareequn fis-sa'eer
ayahs.translationClear: Thus We inspired you with an Arabic Quran, that you may warn the Central City and whoever is around it, and to warn of the Day of Assembly, of which there is no doubt; a group in the Garden, and a group in the Furnace.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ‌ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوْ شَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلٰكِنْ يُّدْخِلُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ فِيْ رَحْمَتِهٖؕ وَالظّٰلِمُوْنَ مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيْرٍ
ayahs.translation: And if Allāh willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills[1409] into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaw shaa'allaahu laja'alahum ummatan waahidatan walaakin yudkhilu man yashaa'u fee rahmatihee waz-zaalimoona maa lahum min waliyyin walaa naseer

footnotes.1409: i.e., those who desire His guidance and His acceptance of them.

ayahs.translationClear: Had Allah willed, He could have made them one community, but He admits into His mercy whomever He wills. As for the wrongdoers, they will have no protector and no savior.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ‌ۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَۚ فَاللّٰهُ هُوَ الْوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰيؗ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides Him? But Allāh - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Amittakhadhoo min doonihee awliyaa'a fallaahu huwal-waliyyu wahuwa yuhyil-mawtaa wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: Or have they adopted protectors besides Him? But Allah is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He has power over all things.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيْهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهٗٓ اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبِّيْ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُࣗۖ وَاِلَيْهِ اُنِيْبُ
ayahs.translation: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allāh. [Say], "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."[1410]
ayahs.transliteration: Wamakhtalaftum feehi min shay'in fahukmuhoo ilallaahi dhaalikumullaahu rabbee 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa'ilayhi uneeb
ayahs.translationClear: Whatever matter you differ about, its judgment rests with Allah. “Such is Allah, my Lord, in whom I trust, and unto Him I repent.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا‌ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ‌ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ‌ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاطِرُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا وَّمِنَ الْاَنْعَامِ اَزْوَاجًاۚ يَذْرَو͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ فِيْهِؕ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهٖ شَيْءٌۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْبَصِيْرُ
ayahs.translation: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him,[1411] and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.[1412]
ayahs.transliteration: Faatirus-samaawaati wal-ardi ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwaajan waminal-an'aami azwaajan yadhra'ukum feehi laysa kamithlihee shay'un wahuwas-samee'ul-baseer

footnotes.1411: There is no similarity whatsoever between the Creator and His creation in essence, in attributes or in deed.

ayahs.translationClear: Originator of the heavens and the earth. He made for you mates from among yourselves, and pairs of animals, by means of which He multiplies you. There is nothing like Him. He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۖ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: لَهٗ مَقَالِيْدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۚ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ وَيَقْدِرُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: Lahoo maqaaleedus-samaawaati wal-ardi yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wayaqdiru innahoo bikulli shay'in 'aleem
ayahs.translationClear: To Him belongs absolute control of the heavens and the earth. He spreads the bounties to whomever He wills, or reduces it. He is aware of all things.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ‌ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ‌ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ‌ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الدِّيْنِ مَا وَصّٰي بِهٖ نُوْحًا وَّالَّذِيْٓ اَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهٖٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَمُوْسٰي وَعِيْسٰٓي اَنْ اَقِيْمُوا الدِّيْنَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوْا فِيْهِؕ كَبُرَ عَلَي الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ مَا تَدْعُوْهُمْ اِلَيْهِؕ اَللّٰهُ يَجْتَبِيْٓ اِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ وَيَهْدِيْٓ اِلَيْهِ مَنْ يُّنِيْبُ
ayahs.translation: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].
ayahs.transliteration: Shara'a lakum minad-deeni maa wassaa bihee noohan wal-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka wamaa wassaynaa bihee ibraaheema wamoosaa wa'eesaa an aqeemud-deena walaa tatafarraqoo feehi kabura 'alal-mushrikeena maa tad'oohum ilayhillaahu yajtabee ilayhi man yashaa'u wayahdee ilayhi man yuneeb
ayahs.translationClear: He prescribed for you the same religion He enjoined upon Noah, and what We inspired to you, and what We enjoined upon Abraham, and Moses, and Jesus: “You shall uphold the religion, and be not divided therein.” As for the idolaters, what you call them to is outrageous to them. Allah chooses to Himself whom He wills, and He guides to Himself whoever repents.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ‌ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ‌ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوْٓا اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَا࢜ءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًاۢ بَيْنَهُمْؕ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ اِلٰٓي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّي لَّقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْؕ وَاِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْرِثُوا الْكِتٰبَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِيْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيْبٍ
ayahs.translation: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word[1413] that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa tafarraqoo illaa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumul-'ilmu baghyam baynahum walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika ilaa ajalim musammal laqudiya baynahum wa'innal-ladheena oorithul-kitaaba mim ba'dihim lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
ayahs.translationClear: They became divided only after knowledge came to them, out of resentment among themselves. Were it not for a predetermined decision from your Lord, judgment would have been pronounced between them. Indeed, those who were made to inherit the Book after them are in grave doubt about it.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدْعُ ۖ وَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَقُلْ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَـٰبٍ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ۖ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَنَآ أَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ ۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ۖ ٱللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدْعُ‌ۖ وَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ‌ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ‌ۖ وَقُلْ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَـٰبٍ‌ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ‌ۖ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ‌ۖ لَنَآ أَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ‌ۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ‌ۖ ٱللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا‌ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلِذٰلِكَ فَادْعُۚ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا͏ٓ اُمِرْتَۚ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَا࢜ءَهُمْۚ وَقُلْ اٰمَنْتُ بِمَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ كِتٰبٍۚ وَاُمِرْتُ لِاَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمْؕ اَللّٰهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْؕ لَنَا͏ٓ اَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ اَعْمَالُكُمْؕ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْؕ اَللّٰهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَاۚ وَاِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيْرُ ؕ
ayahs.translation: So to that [religion of Allāh] invite, [O Muḥammad],[1414] and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allāh has revealed of scripture [i.e., the Qur’ān], and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allāh is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds.[1415] There is no [need for] argument between us and you.[1416] Allāh will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."
ayahs.transliteration: Falidhaalika fad'u wastaqim kamaa umirta walaa tattabi' ahwaa'ahum waqul aamantu bimaa anzalallaahu min kitaabin wa'umirtu li'a'dila baynakumullaahu rabbunaa warabbukum lanaa a'maalunaa walakum a'maalukum laa hujjata baynanaa wabaynakumullaahu yajma'u baynanaa wa'ilayhil-maseer

footnotes.1414: Another meaning understood from the Arabic is "So because of that [division and separation into sects], invite [them back to Allāh]..."
footnotes.1416: Since the truth has been made clear and since those who refuse it do so only out of stubbornness or worldly interests.

ayahs.translationClear: To this go on inviting, and be upright as you were commanded, and do not follow their inclinations, and say, “I believe in whatever Book Allah has sent down, and I was commanded to judge between you equitably. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds, and you have your deeds. Let there be no quarrel between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the ultimate return.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ يُحَا࢜جُّوْنَ فِي اللّٰهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيْبَ لَهٗ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَّلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌ

words.translation: response has been made to Him
response has been made to Him

ayahs.translation: And those who argue concerning Allāh after He has been responded to[1417] - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena yuhaajjoona fillaahi mim ba'di mastujeeba lahoo hujjatuhum daahidatun 'inda rabbihim wa'alayhim ghadabun walahum 'adhaabun shadeed

footnotes.1417: i.e., after people have accepted the truth from Allāh, in an attempt to turn the believers away from His religion of Islām.

ayahs.translationClear: As for those who dispute about Allah after having answered His call, their argument is invalid with their Lord; and upon them falls wrath; and a grievous torment awaits them.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ ۗ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ‌ۗ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْزَلَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيْزَانَؕ وَمَا يُدْرِيْكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيْبٌ
ayahs.translation: It is Allāh who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance [i.e., justice]. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahul-ladhee anzalal-kitaaba bil-haqqi wal-meezaana wamaa yudreeka la'allas-saa'ata qareeb
ayahs.translationClear: It is Allah who revealed the Book with the truth, and the Balance. And what will make you realize that perhaps the Hour is near?

ayahs.textUthmani: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِى ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا‌ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلْحَقُّ‌ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِى ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِهَاۚ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مُشْفِقُوْنَ مِنْهَاۙ وَيَعْلَمُوْنَ اَنَّهَا الْحَقُّؕ اَلَا͏ٓ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُمَارُوْنَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِيْ ضَلٰلٍۭ بَعِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it,[1418] but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.
ayahs.transliteration: Yasta'jilu bihal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bihaa wal-ladheena aamanoo mushfiqoona minhaa waya'lamoona annahal-haqqu alaa innal-ladheena yumaaroona fis-saa'ati lafee dalaalim ba'eed

footnotes.1418: They had challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) to bring it on immediately.

ayahs.translationClear: Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten it; but those who believe are apprehensive of it, and they know it to be the truth. Absolutely, those who question the Hour are in distant error.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ‌ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ لَطِيْفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهٖ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُۚ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيْزُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Allāh is Subtle[1419] with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahu lateefum bi'ibaadihee yarzuqu man yashaa'u wahuwal-qawiyyul-'azeez
ayahs.translationClear: Allah is Kind towards His worshipers. He provides for whomever He wills. He is the Powerful, the Honorable.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُۥ فِى حَرْثِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُۥ فِى حَرْثِهِۦ‌ۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيْدُ حَرْثَ الْاٰخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهٗ فِيْ حَرْثِهٖۚ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُرِيْدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُو͏ٔ͏ْتِهٖ مِنْهَاۙ وَمَا لَهٗ فِي الْاٰخِرَةِ مِنْ نَّصِيْبٍ
ayahs.translation: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest [i.e., reward]. And whoever desires the harvest [i.e., benefits] of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.
ayahs.transliteration: Man kaana yureedu harthal-aakhirati nazid lahoo fee harthihee waman kaana yureedu harthad-dunyaa nu'tihee minhaa wamaa lahoo fil-aakhirati min naseeb
ayahs.translationClear: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter, We increase for him his harvest; and whoever desires the harvest of this world, We give him thereof, and he has no share of the Hereafter.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُا۟ شَرَعُوا۟ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُا۟ شَرَعُوا۟ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ‌ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ‌ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا شَرَعُوْا لَهُمْ مِّنَ الدِّيْنِ مَا لَمْ يَاْذَنْۢ بِهِ اللّٰهُؕ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْؕ وَاِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ

words.translation: Allah has given permission of it
Allah has given permission of it
Allah has given permission of it

ayahs.translation: Or have they partners [i.e., other deities] who have ordained for them a religion to which Allāh has not consented? But if not for the decisive word,[1420] it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Am lahum shurakaa'u shara'oo lahum minad-deeni maa lam ya'dham bihillaahu walawlaa kalimatul-fasli laqudiya baynahum wa'innaz-zaalimeena lahum 'adhaabun aleem
ayahs.translationClear: Or is it that they have partners who litigate for them religious laws never authorized by Allah? Were it not for the conclusive decision, it would have been settled between them. The wicked will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ ۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ‌ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ‌ۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: تَرَي الظّٰلِمِيْنَ مُشْفِقِيْنَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوْا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْؕ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فِيْ رَوْضٰتِ الْجَنّٰتِۚ لَهُمْ مَّا يَشَا࢜ءُوْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيْرُ
ayahs.translation: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.
ayahs.transliteration: Taraz-zaalimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa kasaboo wahuwa waaqi'um bihim wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati fee rawdaatil-jannaati lahum maa yashaa'oona 'inda rabbihim dhaalika huwal-fadlul-kabeer
ayahs.translationClear: You will see the unjust terrified of what they have earned, and it will befall them. As for those who believe and do good deeds, they will be in the Meadows of the Gardens; they will have whatever they please in the presence of their Lord; that is the supreme blessing.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ ۗ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسْنًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ‌ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ‌ۗ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسْنًا‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ الَّذِيْ يُبَشِّرُ اللّٰهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ قُلْ لَّا͏ٓ اَسْـٔ͏َلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اَجْرًا اِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبٰيؕ وَمَنْ يَّقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهٗ فِيْهَا حُسْنًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ شَكُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: It is that of which Allāh gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., this message] any payment [but] only good will through [i.e., due to] kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Appreciative.[1421]
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalikal-ladhee yubashshirullaahu 'ibaadahul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati qul laa as'alukum 'alayhi ajran illal-mawaddata fil-qurbaa waman yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahoo feehaa husnan innallaaha ghafoorun shakoor
ayahs.translationClear: That is the good news Allah gives to His servants who believe and do good deeds. Say, “I ask of you no wage for it, except affection among the near of kin.” Whoever does a good deed, We will increase its goodness for him. Allah is Forgiving and Appreciative.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا ۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ ۗ وَيَمْحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا‌ۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ‌ۗ وَيَمْحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦٓ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاۚ فَاِنْ يَّشَاِ اللّٰهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلٰي قَلْبِكَؕ وَيَمْحُ اللّٰهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allāh a lie"? But if Allāh willed, He could seal over your heart.[1422] And Allāh eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.transliteration: Am yaqooloonaftaraa 'alallaahi kadhiban fa'in yasha'illaahu yakhtim 'alaa qalbika wayamhullaahul-baatila wayuhiqqul-haqqa bikalimaatihee innahoo 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor

footnotes.1422: i.e., He could make you forget the Qur’ān and deprive you of it.

ayahs.translationClear: Or do they say, “He forged a lie about Allah”? If Allah so willed, He could have sealed your heart. But Allah obliterates the false, and confirms the true by His words. He knows what is in the hearts.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَعْفُوْا عَنِ السَّيِّاٰتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee yaqbalut-tawbata 'an 'ibaadihee waya'foo 'anis-sayyi'aati waya'lamu maa taf'aloon
ayahs.translationClear: It is He who accepts the repentance of His worshipers, and remits the sins, and knows what you do.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ‌ۚ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَسْتَجِيْبُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَيَزِيْدُهُمْ مِّنْ فَضْلِهٖؕ وَالْكٰفِرُوْنَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayastajeebul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati wayazeeduhum min fadlihee wal-kaafiroona lahum 'adhaabun shadeed
ayahs.translationClear: And He answers those who believe and do good deeds, and He increases them of His grace. But the disbelievers will suffer a terrible punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَلَوْ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَلَوْ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَآءُ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوْ بَسَطَ اللّٰهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهٖ لَبَغَوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلٰكِنْ يُّنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَا࢜ءُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِيْرٌۢ بَصِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: And if Allāh had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Aware and Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaw basatallaahur-rizqa li'ibaadihee labaghaw fil-ardi walaakin yunazzilu biqadarim maa yashaa'u innahoo bi'ibaadihee khabeerum baseer
ayahs.translationClear: If Allah were to increase the provision to His servants, they would transgress on earth; but He sends down in precise measure whatever He wills. Surely, regarding His servants, He is Expert and Observant.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ‌ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوْا وَيَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهٗؕ وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيْدُ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee yunazzilul-ghaytha mim ba'di maa qanatoo wayanshuru rahmatahoo wahuwal-waliyyul-hameed
ayahs.translationClear: It is He who brings down the rain after they have despaired, and unfolds His mercy. He is the Guardian, the Praised.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ‌ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٌ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيْهِمَا مِنْ دَا࢜بَّةٍؕ وَهُوَ عَلٰي جَمْعِهِمْ اِذَا يَشَا࢜ءُ قَدِيْرٌ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin aayaatihee khalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baththa feehimaa min daabbatin wahuwa 'alaa jam'ihim idhaa yashaa'u qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: And of His signs are the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the creatures He has spread throughout them; and He is Able to gather them at will.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَصَـٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَصَـٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَصَابَكُمْ مِّنْ مُّصِيْبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْا عَنْ كَثِيْرٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa asaabakum mim museebatin fabimaa kasabat aydeekum waya'foo 'an katheer
ayahs.translationClear: Whatever misfortune befalls you, it is because of what your hands have earned; and yet He pardons much.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِيْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِۚۖ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيْرٍ
ayahs.translation: And you will not cause failure [to Allāh][1423] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allāh any protector or helper.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa antum bimu'jizeena fil-ardi wamaa lakum min doonillaahi min waliyyin walaa naseer
ayahs.translationClear: You are not the ones to interfere on earth; and besides Allah, you have no ally, and no helper.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِ ٱلْجَوَارِ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِ ٱلْجَوَارِ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْاَعْلَامِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin aayaatihil-jawaari fil-bahri kal-a'laam
ayahs.translationClear: And of His signs are the ships sailing the sea like flags.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِۦٓ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ يَّشَاْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيْحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلٰي ظَهْرِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوْرٍ ۙ

words.translation: He can cause the wind to become still
He can cause the wind to become still

ayahs.translation: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: In yasha' yuskinir-reeha fayazlalna rawaakida 'alaa zahrihee inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
ayahs.translationClear: If He willed, He could have stilled the winds, leaving them motionless on its surface. Surely in that are signs for every disciplined, grateful person.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْ يُوْبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوْا وَيَعْفُ عَنْ كَثِيْرٍ ؗ
ayahs.translation: Or He could destroy them[1424] for what they earned; but He pardons much.
ayahs.transliteration: Aw yoobiqhunna bimaa kasaboo waya'fu 'an katheer

footnotes.1424: Meaning that Allāh could sink the ships by means of violent winds.

ayahs.translationClear: Or He could wreck them, because of what they have earned. And yet He pardons much.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّيَعْلَمَ الَّذِيْنَ يُجَادِلُوْنَ فِيْٓ اٰيٰتِنَاؕ مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّحِيْصٍ
ayahs.translation: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.
ayahs.transliteration: Waya'lamal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatinaa maa lahum mim mahees
ayahs.translationClear: Those who dispute Our signs know that there is no asylum for them.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَمَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَمَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا‌ۖ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَمَا͏ٓ اُوْتِيْتُمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَاۚ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ خَيْرٌ وَّاَبْقٰي لِلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلٰي رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allāh is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely
ayahs.transliteration: Famaa ooteetum min shay'in famataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa wamaa 'indallaahi khayrun wa'abqaa lilladheena aamanoo wa'alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
ayahs.translationClear: Whatever thing you are given is only the provision of this life. But what Allah possesses is better and more lasting for those who believe and rely on their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا۟ هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا۟ هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَجْتَنِبُوْنَ كَبٰ࢜ىِٕرَ الْاِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ وَاِذَا مَا غَضِبُوْا هُمْ يَغْفِرُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena yajtaniboona kabaa'iral-ithmi wal-fawaahisha wa'idhaa maa ghadiboo hum yaghfiroon
ayahs.translationClear: And those who avoid major sins and indecencies; and if they become angry, they forgive.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ اسْتَجَابُوْا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَاَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَࣕ وَاَمْرُهُمْ شُوْرٰي بَيْنَهُمْࣕ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend,
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheenastajaaboo lirabbihim wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'amruhum shooraa baynahum wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
ayahs.translationClear: And those who respond to their Lord, and pray regularly, and conduct their affairs by mutual consultation, and give of what We have provided them.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلْبَغْىُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلْبَغْىُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ اِذَا͏ٓ اَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْيُ هُمْ يَنْتَصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].[1425]
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena idhaa asaabahumul-baghyu hum yantasiroon

footnotes.1425: Restoring their rights and not allowing aggressors to take advantage of them out of weakness.

ayahs.translationClear: And those who, when wronged, defend themselves.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَزَٰٓؤُا۟ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا ۖ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَزَٰٓؤُا۟ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا‌ۖ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَزٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا سَيِّي͏ٔ͏َةٍ سَيِّي͏ٔ͏َةٌ مِّثْلُهَاۚ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَاَصْلَحَ فَاَجْرُهٗ عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allāh. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wajazaa'u sayyi'atin sayyi'atum mithluhaa faman 'afaa wa'aslaha fa'ajruhoo 'alallaahi innahoo laa yuhibbuz-zaalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: The repayment of a bad action is one equivalent to it. But whoever pardons and makes reconciliation, his reward lies with Allah. He does not love the unjust.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَمَنِ انْتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهٖ فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ مَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْ سَبِيْلٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].
ayahs.transliteration: Walamanintasara ba'da zulmihee fa'ulaa'ika maa 'alayhim min sabeel
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who retaliate after being wronged, there is no blame on them.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ‌ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّمَا السَّبِيْلُ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ يَظْلِمُوْنَ النَّاسَ وَيَبْغُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّؕ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Innamas-sabeelu 'alal-ladheena yazlimoonan-naasa wayabghoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabun aleem
ayahs.translationClear: Blame lies on those who wrong people, and commit aggression in the land without right. These will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَمَنْ صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْاُمُوْرِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.[1426]
ayahs.transliteration: Walaman sabara waghafara inna dhaalika lamin 'azmil-umoor

footnotes.1426: On the part of those seeking the reward of Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: But whoever endures patiently and forgives—that is a sign of real resolve.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِىٍّ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِّن سَبِيلٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِىٍّ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ‌ۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِّن سَبِيلٍ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ وَّلِيٍّ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِهٖؕ وَتَرَي الظّٰلِمِيْنَ لَمَّا رَاَوُا الْعَذَابَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ هَلْ اِلٰي مَرَدٍّ مِّنْ سَبِيْلٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"
ayahs.transliteration: Waman yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min waliyyim mim ba'dihee wataraz-zaalimeena lammaa ra'awul-'adhaaba yaqooloona hal ilaa maraddim min sabeel
ayahs.translationClear: Whoever Allah leaves astray has no protector apart from Him. And you will see the transgressors, when they see the torment, saying, “Is there a way of going back?”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَـٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّ ۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِى عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَـٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّ‌ۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ‌ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِى عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتَرٰىهُمْ يُعْرَضُوْنَ عَلَيْهَا خٰشِعِيْنَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنْظُرُوْنَ مِنْ طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّؕ وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِنَّ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ الَّذِيْنَ خَسِرُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَاَهْلِيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِؕ اَلَا͏ٓ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ فِيْ عَذَابٍ مُّقِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: Wataraahum yu'radoona 'alayhaa khaashi'eena minadh-dhulli yanzuroona min tarfin khafiyyin waqaalal-ladheena aamanoo innal-khaasireenal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wa'ahleehim yawmal-qiyaamati alaa innaz-zaalimeena fee 'adhaabim muqeem
ayahs.translationClear: And you will see them exposed to it, cowering from disgrace, looking with concealed eyes. Those who believed will say, “The losers are those who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection.” Indeed, the evildoers are in a lasting torment.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَ يَنْصُرُوْنَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِؕ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ سَبِيْلٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa kaana lahum min awliyaa'a yansuroonahum min doonillaahi waman yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min sabeel
ayahs.translationClear: They will have no allies to support them against Allah. Whomever Allah leaves astray has no way out.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِسْتَجِيْبُوْا لِرَبِّكُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِؕ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ مَّلْجَاٍ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ وَّمَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ نَّكِيْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.[1427]
ayahs.transliteration: Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli an ya'tiya yawmul laa maradda lahoo minallaahi maa lakum mim malja'in yawma'idhin wamaa lakum min nakeer

footnotes.1427: Of your sins or "disapproval" of your punishment.

ayahs.translationClear: Respond to your Lord before there comes from Allah a Day that cannot be turned back. You will have no refuge on that Day, and no possibility of denial.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ كَفُورٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا‌ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ‌ۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا‌ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ كَفُورٌ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُوْا فَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيْظًاؕ اِنْ عَلَيْكَ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُؕ وَاِنَّا͏ٓ اِذَا͏ٓ اَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَاۚ وَاِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّي͏ٔ͏َةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيْهِمْ فَاِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ كَفُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'in a'radoo famaa arsalnaaka 'alayhim hafeezan in 'alayka illal-balaaghu wa'innaa idhaa adhaqnal-insaana minnaa rahmatan fariha bihaa wa'in tusibhum sayyi'atum bimaa qaddamat aydeehim fa'innal-insaana kafoor
ayahs.translationClear: But if they turn away—We did not send you as a guardian over them. Your only duty is communication. Whenever We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but when misfortune befalls them, as a consequence of what their hands have perpetrated, man turns blasphemous.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَـٰثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ‌ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَـٰثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: لِلّٰهِ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَا࢜ءُؕ يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ اِنَاثًا وَّيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ الذُّكُوْرَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
ayahs.transliteration: Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi yakhluqu maa yashaa'u yahabu liman yashaa'u inaathan wayahabu liman yashaa'udh-dhukoor
ayahs.translationClear: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wills. He grants daughters to whomever He wills, and He grants sons to whomever He wills.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَـٰثًا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَـٰثًا‌ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَّاِنَاثًاۚ وَيَجْعَلُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ عَقِيْمًاؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Aw yuzawwijuhum dhukraanan wa'inaathan wayaj'alu man yashaa'u 'aqeeman innahoo 'aleemun qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: Or He combines them together, males and females; and He renders whomever He wills sterile. He is Knowledgeable and Capable.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ اَنْ يُّكَلِّمَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا وَحْيًا اَوْ مِنْ وَّرَا࢜ي͏ٔ͏ِ حِجَابٍ اَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُوْلًا فَيُوْحِيَ بِاِذْنِهٖ مَا يَشَا࢜ءُؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa kaana libasharin an yukallimahullaahu illaa wahyan aw min waraa'i hijaabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya bi'idhnihee maa yashaa'u innahoo 'aliyyun hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: It is not for any human that Allah should speak to him, except by inspiration, or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger to reveal by His permission whatever He wills. He is All-High, All-Wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا‌ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا‌ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكَ رُوْحًا مِّنْ اَمْرِنَاؕ مَا كُنْتَ تَدْرِيْ مَا الْكِتٰبُ وَلَا الْاِيْمَانُ وَلٰكِنْ جَعَلْنٰهُ نُوْرًا نَّهْدِيْ بِهٖ مَنْ نَّشَا࢜ءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَاؕ وَاِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِيْٓ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -
ayahs.transliteration: Wakadhaalika awhaynaa ilayka rooham min amrinaa maa kunta tadree mal-kitaabu walal-eemaanu walaakin ja'alnaahu nooran nahdee bihee man nashaa'u min 'ibaadinaa wa'innaka latahdee ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: We thus inspired you spiritually, by Our command. You did not know what the Scripture is, nor what faith is, but We made it a light, with which We guide whomever We will of Our servants. You surely guide to a straight path.

ayahs.textUthmani: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: صِرَاطِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِؕ اَلَا͏ٓ اِلَي اللّٰهِ تَصِيْرُ الْاُمُوْرُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].
ayahs.transliteration: Siraatillaahil-ladhee lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi alaa ilallaahi taseerul-umoor
ayahs.translationClear: The path of Allah, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Indeed, to Allah all matters revert.
